capabilityModules.description: Strict RFC 0001 composition boundary. Permissions for includes and Waf links are owned here; no legacy baseline applies.

targetOwners.description: RFC 0001 'Waf target checks' migration sidecar. Every recorded Waf target declares its owner capability module with arch_module in its wscript (checked when the target is posted, and by archlint targets), or is listed in exactly one legacy group here: legacy code whose links no module bounds yet, counted but not judged. Each group names the roadmap row that retires it. New targets declare arch_module; groups only shrink.

legacy.reason: Legacy engine, tier and domain libraries and their launch roots; RFC 0001 rank 21 decomposes them into owned domain targets.
Legacy VGUI and game UI libraries; RFC 0010 keeps their API frozen while their internals move behind owned seams.

Legacy material system and shader API modules. materialsystem, shaderapivulkan and shaderapidx9 compile strict modules beside legacy code (the provider catalog links shaderapivulkan; R39), so no single module bounds them.
Render test hosts that link the legacy shader API modules or legacy-dialect fixtures; each moves to a native-test module when its fixture code is strict.
IVP simulation and the legacy VPhysics module; retired after the Box3D default gate.
The Box3D VPhysics provider, its pinned C17 library and its conformance host, still in the legacy dialect behind the frozen VPhysics ABI.
Map compile tools and their shared libraries (vbsp, vvis, vrad), built on Waf but still legacy code.
Texture tools and the vtex launchable-module remnant; the tool process contract replaces their wrappers.
The vbsp2 World Stage compiler and its OpenUSD ABI island (quality/toolchain/policy.json).
Dedicated-server composition bridge and its test host.
Job-system test and benchmark hosts in the legacy dialect.
Audio, voice and video provider-catalog test hosts for the launcher's typed descriptors.
Legacy tier unit tests and the unittest_legacy host with its loader fixtures (R07 owns the loader telemetry they exercise).
Feature-gated (--debug-api) debug API core; it compiles native Vulkan capture sources beside its legacy-dialect server.

sharedLibraries.description: First-party shared libraries the declared build trees build (archlint targets, CAP009). iOS links every first-party module statically (AGENTS.md 'Platform-compliant composition'), so each one is reviewed here: debt the iOS client must link statically, a module no iOS profile selects, or a desktop loader-test fixture. A new shared library fails until it is linked statically or reviewed into a group; entries that no tree builds are stale.

groups.reason: Client product modules the iOS profile must link statically through typed factories; each leaves this list when its target becomes a static library.
The dedicated server module; no iOS profile ships the dedicated product.
D3D9 and togl render backends; no iOS profile selects them (iOS renders through native Vulkan on MoltenVK).
Tool-only libraries (vtex launchable remnant); no iOS product builds tools.
The vbsp2 OpenUSD island library, a host tool.
Desktop test hosts and fixtures that exist to exercise dynamic module loading; iOS test profiles exclude first-party shared-module loading.

description: RFC 0001 architectural manifest. Phase A currently freezes legacy dynamic-loader boundaries.

legacyAbi.description: Preserved binary ABI declarations and exact private compatibility adapters/tests. Video provider runtime supplies the existing IVideoSubSystem::Connect factory without exposing it through the typed catalog. The Linux VBSP host tool keeps its material and physics factories in its private legacy compile-tool adapters. Reviewed 2026-09-25 (R04-DRIFT, user decision): the imported matchmaking framework's IAppSystem::Connect, the Portal 2 GameUI's IGameUI::Initialize/Connect, the Box3D provider's IPhysics::QueryInterface and the VPhysics conformance test host, which loads each provider through its CreateInterface export.

loaderExceptions.description: RFC 0001 'Baseline and exceptions': reviewed exceptions to the ARCH101-ARCH105 loader ratchet. Each names one file, one rule and the exact number of unbaselined occurrences it covers, with a reason, an owning roadmap row, a tracking record and a removal condition. archlint fails on a count mismatch or a stale entry. Added 2026-09-25 by R04-DRIFT (user decision) for the Portal 2 reconstruction glue.
